_comment: MCP client config for the android-control server.
Claude Desktop : merge the `mcpServers` object into
Cursor           : Settings > MCP > Add, or project .cursor/mcp.json
Claude Code      : claude mcp add android-control -- <command> <args...>
ABSOLUTE PATHS ONLY -- MCP clients do not inherit your shell's cwd.
Replace /ABSOLUTE/PATH/TO with the real path to this android-control folder.

_variant_explicit_adb._comment: Only needed if `adb` is not on PATH and adbutils is not installed.

_verify._comment: Smoke-test the server without a client. Expect tool_count >= 24.
